title: Fix Headings Hierarchy in Zwischenbericht
description: Ensure that no chapters, sections, etc are skipping hierarchies in the zwischenbericht and zwischenbericht-dark files, specifically the forschungsfragen should be subsections (1.1.1 etc).
summary: Corrected heading hierarchy skips in LaTeX report files by promoting nested paragraphs directly under sections/subsections to subsections/subsubsections and removing unnecessary SemioNest environments.
